name: Arion Star
description: Arion Star was a stock light freighter that was nothing special in terms of appearance. But, upon closer inspection, it was found that the light did not work in the cargo bay, and the engine repair hatch was stuck; although, it could still be opened. It was given to a group of Rebels who were posing as members of NavStar Transport, a Rebel front company, when they were assigned to collect supplies from Greyman's Planet and deliver them to Karinda Outpost.
